Beginning to trace the profile image request through the serving handler and data layer.

Store.GetUser delegates to driver.ListUsers. The browser avatar URL comes from the fromAvatar component via an API avatarUrl. The route pattern is /file/users/:identifier/avatar, where the identifier maps to a userpb.Name formatted as users/username.

Confirmed the full URL resolves to `/file/users/username/avatar`. Now tracing the store layer to the database.

The browser request begins with the UserAvatar component, which loads the image via an img tag using avatarUrl.

The API returns avatar URLs in the format `/file/users/{username}/avatar`. The browser requests this exact path. The HTTP route is registered in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`.

The handler lives in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`. It calls `getUserByUsername`, which fetches the user via `Store.GetUser` in `store/user.go`. That method invokes `ListUsers`, which queries the database driver in `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/user.go` for the `avatar_url` column. The handler then decodes the base64 data URI and returns the image bytes via `c.Blob`. `server/server.go` wires the `FileServerService` into the Echo router.

message.text:
The full picture is now clear. I am formatting the answer.

The trace covers ten hops from the browser request to the stored image. The chain runs from the UserAvatar img tag through route registration and serveUserAvatar to getUserByUsername, then Store.GetUser and Store.ListUsers, down to the driver.ListUsers SQL query selecting avatar_url, back up through parseDataURI decoding the base64 value, and finally to c.Blob serving the bytes.

The browser learns the avatar URL from `convertUserFromStore` in `user_service_converters.go`, which builds `/file/{name}/avatar`. The frontend `UserAvatar` component in `web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx` sets the image source. The backend route is registered in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`, and `serveUserAvatar` handles the request.

getUserByUsername is in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`. Store.GetUser and Store.ListUsers are in `store/user.go`. The driver interface is in `store/driver.go`. The SQL query lives in the database-specific driver, such as `store/db/sqlite/user.go`. The avatar_url column stores the image as a base64 data URI. parseDataURI is in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`. c.Blob returns the decoded bytes to the browser.

External avatar URLs bypass this path entirely; the browser fetches them directly. The avatar data is stored inline in the `user.avatar_url` column as a base64 data URI string, not as a separate disk file.
